rows.question: Can I repeat a failed module? How do I register?
rows.expected_answer: Repeat the module at the next scheduled offering after the examination board confirms the result. Submit the repeat registration form in the Student Portal and attach the applicable payment receipt.
rows.answer:
- Students who fail a module may repeat it at the next scheduled offering after the examination board confirms the result. [assessment-regulations.pdf, p. 1]
- To register for a repeat module, submit the repeat registration form in the Student Portal and attach the applicable payment receipt. [student-registration.pdf, p. 1]

rows.question: How do I register for a repeat module?
rows.expected_answer: Submit the repeat registration form through the Student Portal and attach the applicable payment receipt.
rows.answer: - To register for a repeat module, submit the repeat registration form in the Student Portal and attach the applicable payment receipt. [student-registration.pdf, p. 1]

rows.question: When does repeat registration close?
rows.expected_answer: It closes seven calendar days before the teaching period begins.
rows.answer: - Repeat registration closes seven calendar days before the teaching period begins. [student-registration.pdf, p. 2]

rows.question: If I miss an exam for medical reasons, what must I submit?
rows.expected_answer: Submit the medical absence form and a medical certificate within three working days.
rows.answer: - A student who misses an examination for medical reasons must submit the medical absence form and a medical certificate within three working days. [assessment-regulations.pdf, p. 2]

rows.question: When can I request a mark review?
rows.expected_answer: Within five working days of publication of the provisional result.
rows.answer: - A student may request a mark review within five working days of publication of the provisional result. [assessment-regulations.pdf, p. 3]

rows.question: Where do I submit an academic appeal?
rows.expected_answer: Submit it to the Academic Appeals Office after the mark review decision.
rows.answer: - An academic appeal may be submitted to the Academic Appeals Office only after the mark review decision. [assessment-regulations.pdf, p. 4]

rows.question: How do I withdraw from a module without penalty?
rows.expected_answer: Submit the module withdrawal form during the first two teaching weeks.
rows.answer: - A student can withdraw from a module without academic penalty during the first two teaching weeks by submitting the module withdrawal form. [student-registration.pdf, p. 3]

rows.question: What do I do if I have a timetable clash?
rows.expected_answer: Email the Programme Office and include both module codes and the affected class times.
rows.answer: - For a timetable clash, email the Programme Office and include both module codes and the affected class times. [student-registration.pdf, p. 4]

rows.question: Who do I contact for exam accommodations?
rows.expected_answer: Contact the Accessibility Office with supporting documentation at least four weeks before the exam period.
rows.answer: - To request examination accommodations, contact the Accessibility Office with supporting documentation at least four weeks before the examination period. [student-support.pdf, p. 1]

rows.question: Where can I request a replacement student ID card?
rows.expected_answer: At the Student Services Desk with a valid photo ID and a completed card replacement form.
rows.answer: - A replacement student ID card can be requested at the Student Services Desk with a valid photo ID and a completed card replacement form. [student-support.pdf, p. 2]

rows.question: What is the processing time for an enrollment letter?
rows.expected_answer: The standard processing time is two working days.
rows.answer: - Request an enrollment letter through the Student Records Portal. The standard processing time is two working days. [student-support.pdf, p. 3]

rows.question: How do I order a transcript and how long does it take to process the transcript?
rows.expected_answer: Request it using the transcript request form in the Student Records Portal. Processing takes five working days.
rows.answer:
- Request an official transcript through the Student Records Portal using the transcript request form. [student-support.pdf, p. 4]
- The standard processing time for a transcript is five working days. [student-support.pdf, p. 4]
